examples.arabic: قلوبنا كانت بتدق بسرعة في آخر دقايق من الماتش.
examples.english: Our hearts were beating fast in the last minutes of the match.
examples.transliteration: Oloobna kanet betde' be sor'a fi akher da'ayeq mel matsh.

examples.arabic: مش معقول كمية الكلام اللي بيقولها في خمس دقايق بس
examples.english: It's unbelievable the amount of talking he does in just five minutes.
examples.transliteration: Mish ma'oul kammiyya el-kalam elli biy'oolha fi khams da'ayeq bas.

examples.english: I have been waiting for ten minutes.

examples.arabic: عندي يا دوب عشر دقايق عشان اجهز
examples.english: I have barely ten minutes to get ready.
examples.transliteration: Andi ya doob ashar da'aye' ashan agehaz.

examples.arabic: الفريق بتاعنا جاب جولين في اول عشر دقايق
examples.english: Our team scored two goals in the first ten minutes
examples.transliteration: El-faree' beta'na gab goleen fi awwal 'ashar da'aye'

examples.arabic: صاحبي وصل يا دوب بعد خمس دقايق
examples.english: My friend arrived after barely five minutes
examples.transliteration: Saḥbi waṣal ya doob ba'd khamas da'aye'
